scripts.db:migrate: uv run alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:test:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres-test && PYTHONPATH=apps/api/src uv run python -m needradar.testing.database_safety bootstrap
scripts.db:test:verify: PYTHONPATH=apps/api/src uv run python -m needradar.testing.database_safety verify
scripts.db:test:migrate: PYTHONPATH=apps/api/src uv run python -m needradar.testing.database_safety prepare
scripts.check: pnpm check:web && pnpm check:api && pnpm check:openapi && pnpm check:scope && pnpm check:quality-docs
scripts.check:api: uv run ruff format --check apps/api/src apps/api/tests scripts/quality && uv run ruff check apps/api/src apps/api/tests scripts/quality && uv run mypy apps/api/src
scripts.generate:openapi: uv run python scripts/quality/export_openapi.py apps/api/openapi.json && pnpm exec openapi-typescript apps/api/openapi.json -o apps/web/src/lib/api/generated/schema.ts
scripts.test:unit: uv run pytest -m unit apps/api/tests/unit && pnpm test:web
scripts.test:integration: pnpm db:test:up && uv run pytest -m integration apps/api/tests/integration
scripts.test:migration: pnpm db:test:up && uv run pytest -m migration apps/api/tests/integration/test_migrations.py
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm db:test:up && pnpm db:test:migrate && pnpm exec playwright test
